description: This file defines a React hook (`useProgressiveExpand`) and a utility function (`createProgressiveExpandController`) to manage batching and progressive processing, particularly for expanding items or similar deferred work in a React application. It handles incremental execution with fallbacks for browsers without `requestIdleCallback`, provides progress tracking, and supports cancellation. The code is primarily geared towards UI updates to keep the interface responsive during large batch operations.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches with progressive, interruptible execution, either using `requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout` fallback. Supports progress reporting and cancellation.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps around `createProgressiveExpandController`, managing React state for running status, progress, and counts. It provides an API to start processing items in batches and cancel ongoing work.
